title: Merchandise Purchases — Registry Price Protection Refund Worksheet
content:
The registry price protection refund on a Merchandise Purchases unit is the figure defined below.

**1. Protection base price.** The new unit price of the unit's latest earlier price-drop adjustment when it has one; otherwise the shelf ticket price when the unit carries a register-error correction to that ticket; otherwise the unit's selling price.

**2. Protection lower price.** The net price of the latest guest gift of the identical item recorded on the registrant's registry.

**3. Protection difference.** The protection base price less the protection lower price, and never below zero.

**4. Store value on the unit.** The Finch Notes shown applied on the purchase record plus, once the unit's records carry a register-error correction recording no new unit price, the registry credit spent on the unit.

**5. Paid-share difference.** The protection difference less the whole store value, and never below zero.

**6. Protected difference.** The paid-share difference multiplied by the protection tenure uplift of 1.00 and rounded half up to the cent; it never exceeds the protection cap of $30.00.

**7. Sales tax on the protected difference.** The unit's tax amount times the capped protected difference divided by the unit's selling price, rounded half up to the cent.

**8. Refund.** The capped protected difference plus its sales tax plus the protection card goodwill of $0.00 plus the registry status goodwill of $0.00 plus the protection spend bonus of $0.00, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Selling price $200.00, tax $16.00, $20.00 of Finch Notes applied; no earlier adjustment or correction on the unit; latest guest gift of the same item recorded at a net price of $150.00.

| Line | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Base price | the selling price | $200.00 |
| Difference | $200.00 less $150.00 | $50.00 |
| Store value | Finch Notes applied | $20.00 |
| Paid-share difference | $50.00 less $20.00 | $30.00 |
| Protected difference | $30.00 multiplied by 1.00, within the $30.00 cap | $30.00 |
| Tax on it | $16.00 times $30.00 divided by $200.00 | $2.40 |
| Refund | $30.00 plus $2.40 plus $0.00 plus $0.00 plus $0.00 | $32.40 |

## Variations of the inputs (hypothetical)

- *With no Finch Notes:* the paid-share difference is $50.00 and the protected difference is held at the $30.00 cap.
- *After an earlier price-drop adjustment to $180.00:* the base price is $180.00 and the difference $30.00.
- *After a register-error correction to a $190.00 shelf ticket and no price-drop adjustment:* the base price is $190.00.
- *A guest gift at a net price above the base price:* the difference is zero.
